notes: 2605.06614 SkillOS (seat Δ6.25): final 66.25, between the seats (sol 70.0, son55 63.75). X → sol 3: the insert/update/delete interface, BM25 top-5 read, write-back after every task and Table 4 hyperparameters are given; there is no gate, rollback or size bound. E.causality → son55 2: store-off (No Memory), untrained-curator (SkillOS-base) and Gemini-curator arms exist, but there is no frozen-repo or no-experience arm, no RL-curator neighbour, and the Table 3 ablations are single-run on ALFWorld only, with drops (2.6/1.2/3.9) inside the main-table SD (±4.6). E.holdout → sol 2: the test-time stream protocol (order, reset, number of passes, use of task-type grouping) is never stated (opus:O01), ALFWorld uses valid_seen (opus:O04), and there is no frozen-store evaluation. The H26 card's step 4 and failure mode name exactly this case: online accumulation during evaluation. A2: the stream-protocol defect is scored once, in E.holdout, not again in X. Paper facts recorded: the training reward is self-judged by the frozen executor (opus:O02); '+7.9 vs base' is 8.1 in Table 1 (opus:O03); Table 4's KL 0.001 contradicts 'we discard the KL term' (opus:O05). These are ≤0.2-pp secondary mismatches and the headline numbers check out, so the run's E.measurement cap is not applied. RS → son55 self_supervised_signal_engineering (sub null) plus adapt_via_conditioning (sub null; C03 needs a reader trained to read the schema, and the executor is frozen).

2605.06822 SHARP (Δ1.25): final 68.75 = sol. E.measurement → sol 2. The 5-bps charge is applied to entries only, while the random null counts a flip as two trades (sol:E014). Appendix A promises baseline implementations but describes only Random/Momentum/MeanRev/Static, so FinCon, FinHEAR and Lopez-Lira are undocumented (opus:O02, son55:E019). §4.2 calls the remaining baselines 'economically negligible', but Table 1 gives FinHEAR-4o a 3-sector mean of 11.1% and FinCon-4.1 9.0%, and SHARP-4.1 (13.4%) is below FinCon-4o (15.9%) (opus:O01). Run convention: text–table contradiction caps the item at 2. E.causality → sol 3. Static (no evolution) is run on all four backbones: it is below Evo in all 6 sector cells for the 4o/4.1 backbones and in both 3-sector averages for Qwen/Llama. A2 is a purpose-built alternative-optimizer arm (free-form rewrite with the same init, budget and gate) and A1 removes attribution. The remaining gaps are single-sector ablations and no gate-off arm. Single runs are scored in E.statistics (A2 rule), not here. RS → sol generative_process_redesign: the fixed component is the free-text mutation operator/representation. son55 itself rated structural_prior_encoding as weak.

2605.08083 AutoTTS (Δ3.75): final 65.0 = sol. G → sol 3. The bottleneck is concrete: costly online evaluation, hyperparameter blow-up and uninformative scalar feedback, each demonstrated by the paper's own replay/β/trace ablations. The TTS lineage (SC/ASC/ESC/Parallel-Probe) is compared empirically and the discovery lineage (Meta-Harness/ADAS) is named. son55's main G reason, that automated tuning of existing controllers is not considered, is an alternative-optimizer control. It is scored in E.causality=2 (A2 rule), not again in G. Shared ratings confirmed: Table 3's 'Avg' includes the search set but the text calls it held-out (sol:E016/E017). At 4B/8B, ASC dominates some AutoTTS operating points (son55:E024), contradicting the figure-only 'consistently stronger frontier' (opus:O01). The $39.9 excludes the 128-trajectory pre-sampling. sol's rs_pattern.primary was written as a {main_id, sub_id} object; it is read as generative_process_redesign (a schema variance, not blocking). RS → son55 reframe_as_solvable_object primary + sol generative_process_redesign supporting. Domain → son55 H14 (the card names replay evaluators and control-policy genomes) + sol H17 (frozen offline design). H12 (low) is dropped.

2605.08374 MemQ (Δ5): final 66.25, below both seats (sol 68.75, son55 73.75). E.causality → sol 2. The γ=0/λ=0 arms are clean, but they cover 3 of 5 benchmarks with 35–116-task evaluation sets. The headline MemQ>MemRL margins are confounded with configuration: initial Q is 0.66 vs 0 on DSBench/AutomationBench, the two benchmarks the paper cites for its largest gains, and Table 6 shows initialization moves LCB eval by 17 pp; w_s/w_q and batch size also differ (son55:E026, son55:E015). E.cost → sol 2: token totals cover 1 of 8 benchmarks, the gap is within one SD, and DAG upkeep is only asymptotic. Shared correction: E.measurement 3 → 2. Table 11 gives MemQ-LCB w_s/w_q = 0.4/0.6, yet the reported held-out 51.43 equals the Table 7 row for 0.6/0.4, which §5.4 calls 'the reported mixed ranking' (opus:O01). The 0.4/0.6 row is 48.57, and Table 6/7's Final/CSR (61.79/67.62) differ from Table 2 (64.76/69.76). BFCL eval is 62.83 in Table 6 vs 62.38 in Table 1. The Table 3 coverage gaps are cited as 'Table 4' (opus:O03). Domain → son55 H29 + H03. RS → reframe_as_solvable_object only; C03 is not kept (no reader is trained).

2605.08399 CoCoDA (Δ10, adjudicated item by item): final 50.0, below both seats (sol 56.25, son55 66.25). G → son55 2: the trained libraries hold 205–382 tools (Table 5) and accuracy plateaus by ~400, so the context-budget bottleneck that motivates TDR does not bind in the regime the method produces. The 'missing quadrant' is the paper's own taxonomy (the H-Mem precedent). M → sol 2. The formal support for the design is invalid. Theorem 1 infers o(C_flat) from a limsup ratio ≤ α1α2 < 1, and L2 still ranks all α1·n L1 survivors. Corollary 5's log-depth argument fails on a chain (sol:E031). The Theorem 4 library step assumes LLM-judged L3 checks certify equivalence. The saved-call reward can credit unnecessary composites, which the authors concede (sol:E025). X → sol 2: the admission gate is self-contradictory. R_res is binary {0,1} (Table 4), yet the ρ sweep reports 419/364/207 retained composites at ρ = 0.5/0.8/1.0, which is impossible on fixed binary rewards (sol:E019, sol:E026). Equivalence validation is an LLM prompt, and the EvalPlus query stream is undefined. E.holdout → sol 2. EvalPlus has no training split, but an EvalPlus library was evolved (Table 5/6). λ and k2 were chosen on GSM8K test accuracy: Table 8's λ=0.20 value equals the Table 1 test score, and no validation split exists (opus:O02, opus:O03, opus:O05). E.cost → sol 2: no baseline or teacher bill, no matched budget, and Figure 2(b)'s 1,600-node regime is never produced by training (opus:O04). Shared correction: E.measurement 3 → 2. Table 2's Δ column does not equal the mean of its own per-benchmark drops: −1.97 vs −1.79 for TDR, −4.46 vs −4.64, −5.01 vs −5.18 (opus:O01). The appendix says the all-off variant equals a ReTool-style planner, yet it sits 3–5 pts below ReTool (son55:E012). Tool counts disagree: 1,873 vs 309, and 42 vs 14–22 primitives (son55:E020). E.causality=2 is confirmed. CoCoDA beats ReTool in all 24 cells, but by 0.1–1.6 pts with SD ≤ 0.4–0.7, and parity (teacher SFT, tool inventory) is unstated. RS → son55 decompose_and_delegate C25 + structural_prior_encoding (sub null; C13 requires message passing over the wiring). Domain → union H08 + H04 + H28.
